system.description:
On your Fear Checks you may re-roll any dice showing Heart symbols. OPDQ: roll a CR 1 Heart Check to lower an ally's Fear Status by 1 step.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.50
system.summary: On your Fear Checks you may re-roll any dice showing Heart symbols. OPDQ: roll a CR 1 Heart Check to lower an ally's Fear Status by 1 step.

automation.note: Passive: on your own Fear Checks, you may re-roll any dice that show Heart symbols.

automation.label: Target the ally to calm
automation.onSuccess: The targeted ally's Fear Status drops 1 step (Terrified to Afraid, or Afraid to Stable).
